nodes.label: Finding 1 — controller Service needs a reachability knob
nodes.rationale: Envoy/ingress works only as L4 passthrough, never TLS termination — the Sync mTLS client cert must reach the controller intact and enroll verifies the controller's CA-signed cert.

nodes.label: Finding 2 — observe-UDP SNAT silently forces relay-always
nodes.rationale: The controller derives each gateway's candidate from the observe packet's source address; any SNAT records the proxy's address instead. Failure is silent and misleading — enrollment and Sync still succeed, the mesh comes up, and every pair falls back to the relay with no error to point at.

nodes.label: Finding 3 — gateway could not take a hostname for Sync/observe (DDNS)
nodes.rationale: LANDED 2026-07-27: host:port with syntax-only parse validation so fail-static boot never needs DNS, re-resolution on every Sync reconnect and observe tick, domain_name("127.0.0.1") unchanged.

nodes.label: Hostname-agnostic pinned-SNI TLS model
nodes.rationale: Trust is anchored in the pinned private CA plus mTLS, not public PKI hostname validation, so a dynamic IP behind DDNS is transparent to TLS — no cert regeneration and no DDNS name in the cert.
